name: Artists of Swadhin Bangla Betar Kendra
name_en: Artists of Swadhin Bangla Betar Kendra
contribution: Through songs, poetry, news, and satire, they sustained wartime morale and carried the message of liberation across borders.
context: 1971, Swadhin Bangla Betar Kendra broadcasts reaching freedom fighters, refugee camps, and civilian audiences.
impact: They turned cultural communication into a form of resistance, framing the war as a battle for public spirit as much as territory.
highlight: On radio waves, courage became contagious.
